messages:
Nina (CSM): FYI MapleLabs dropped to near-zero after PoC handoff yesterday. usage down ~88%. anyone tracking?
Carlos (AE): saw it on the dashboard. procurement said a new ML lead (Owen) is running a parallel test with DriftAI.
Hana (Solutions Eng): any config changes on our side around the 11/25 cutoff? model swap or quantize rollout?
Nina (CSM): quick audit: only a minor telemetry change on 11/24. query: ```SELECT day, sum(requests) FROM api_calls WHERE account='maplelabs' AND day>='2025-11-01' GROUP BY day;``` shows cliff after 11/24.
billing-bot: invoice MAPL-2025-11 created 2025-11-25 status: unpaid.
Owen (MapleLabs): Hey team  we paused calls while leadership validates cost on long-document folding. DriftAI demoed a prefetch+prune flow that looked cheaper in their tests. also security wants a VPC diagram and KMS policy.
Ravi (MapleLabs): procurement asked for side-by-side token cost numbers and latency p95.
Carlos (AE): plan: send VPC/KMS + SOC2 checklist, prepare cost comparison vs DriftAI, and offer a 5-day no-charge dedicated trial with prefetch/KV enabled.
Hana (Solutions Eng): mitigation: enable prefix KV for top templates, add adaptive chunking for >15k token inputs, and run a before/after token-cost sim. expect ~25-35% token reduction for their workload.
Nina (CSM): suggested outreach: "Owen/Ravi  we can send the security pack today and run a 5-day dedicated trial (no charge) with prefetch + KV caching so you can compare real results vs DriftAI. can we book 30m tomorrow?"
Owen (MapleLabs): sounds good. please send the VPC/KMS docs first for security review. Thu 11am works for the call.
Nina (CSM): action items: Nina -> send security/KMS pack + schedule; Hana -> perf sim + KV config; Carlos -> competitive pricing slide and trial terms. billing-bot: payment reminder sent to customer billing contact.
Nina (CSM): keeping this high priority. will update after Thu call. :eyes:
